parts.label: (i)
parts.answer: Two box-and-whisker plots on the same scale: girls $(5,5.5,7,9,13)$ and boys $(4,6,8.5,11,16)$, with appropriate labels and seconds.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: B1: Labels ‘time’ and ‘seconds’, ‘boys’ and ‘girls’ on correct plots and scaled line. B1: One box and whisker all correct on graph paper - ignore boy or girl label. B1: Second box and whisker all correct (on graph paper and ignore boy/girl label) on SAME scaled line. [3]

parts.label: (ii)
parts.answer: Any two valid comparisons, for example: the girls are generally quicker (lower median), and the girls’ times are less spread out (smaller range and interquartile range).
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Girls smaller range or IQ range than boys / girls less spread out oe. B1. Girls generally quicker than boys or girls’ median is lower than boys’ median (not mean) oe. B1. Boys almost symmetrical, girls positively skewed oe. Guidance: Any 2 comments - MUST be a comparison. [2]
